'''''Scoundrels''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[January 1]], [[2013]]. It features [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in an "[[Wikipedia:Ocean's 11|''Ocean's 11'']]–type [[Marblewood Estate heist|heist]] caper" following the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
